portugal_policy.title: 🇵🇹 Portugal Policy & Law
portugal_policy.content:
No significant laws, decree-laws, or portarias were approved or entered into force between November 12 and November 19, 2026. Legislative activity is currently concentrated on the finalization of the 2027 State Budget (Orçamento do Estado) and the government's internal negotiations regarding the 2027 National Minimum Wage.

Why it matters: The upcoming 2027 budget and wage announcements will establish the critical fiscal and labor cost parameters for all Portuguese businesses and investors for the next calendar year.

investment_markets.title: Markets & Economy
investment_markets.content:
SECTOR ALERTS

**[Gold & Silver — Macro]:** US 10Y Treasury yields have climbed to 5.07%, pushing real yields (TIPS) to +2.89%. This increase in real rates makes non-yielding assets less attractive relative to fixed income. This creates a significant macro headwind for Pedro's long-term gold and silver holdings, pushing them into extreme oversold territory relative to their 200MA. [Treasury Data]

Why it matters: The convergence of extreme oversold RSI levels in precious metals (<30) with a spike in real yields suggests a high-probability reversal window for long-term commodity positioning.

ai_tools_snapshot.title: AI Tools Snapshot
ai_tools_snapshot.content:
AI TOOLS SNAPSHOT
Category | Pedro uses | Best today | Alternative | Cost/Plan | Migration effort | Switch? | Reason
Coding / Agents | Claude Code + GPT Codex | Claude Code | Cursor | $20/mo | Low | Optimal | Claude Code integrated with Claude Pro is currently the peak agentic experience for developers.
Excel / Spreadsheets | Claude.ai | Rows.com | Equals | Free tier | Low | Consider | Rows offers native AI cells and live API integrations that Claude cannot execute.
Presentations | Claude.ai | Gamma | Tome | Free tier | Low | Upgrade | Gamma generates full visual decks with design layouts, whereas Claude only provides text outlines.
Documents / Word | Claude.ai | Claude.ai | Notion AI | $10/mo | Low | Optimal | Claude's massive context window makes it superior for drafting and analyzing long-form documents.
LaTeX / Overleaf | Overleaf + Claude.ai | Overleaf + Claude.ai | Typst | Free | Medium | Optimal | This combination remains the industry standard for high-fidelity academic publishing.
Knowledge Management | Claude.ai | Obsidian | Notion | Free | High | Upgrade | Claude is session-based; Obsidian provides a permanent, linked local vault for long-term knowledge.
Image Generation | GPT-4o / Nano Banana 2 | Midjourney v7 | DALL-E 3 | $10/mo | Low | Consider | Midjourney consistently outperforms Gemini 3.1 in photorealism and artistic prompt adherence.
Research / Web Search | Perplexity | Perplexity | SearchGPT | Free | Low | Optimal | Perplexity's citation engine and Pro Search remain the gold standard for verifiable research.
Transcription / Audio | None | OpenAI Whisper | Otter.ai | Free (Local) | Low | Upgrade | Whisper (local installation) provides near-perfect, private transcription for free.
Task Automation | Claude.ai | Zapier Central | Make.com | Free tier | Medium | Upgrade | Zapier Central allows AI agents to trigger actual actions across 6,000+ apps instead of just suggesting them.

Takeaway: Fill the biggest gap in your stack by deploying OpenAI Whisper locally for free, high-accuracy transcription.
